slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
仙古域，斗伐一族慕容氏府邸。
白气连绵，阳光洒落下，四处皆是亮光闪烁，这里楼宇矗立在白气之中，仿佛如同虚幻般从虚空中长出，露出的一角都是雕栏玉砌且无比奢华，藏在白气中的楼台若隐若现，门口的金色雕像似狮似貅，在阳光下显得无比刺眼，祥和而又平静的地方一个人影行色匆匆的朝前而去...
但凡他所踏过之地，白雾自动避开，露出干净而又整齐的浅色地砖，而两旁玉栏洁白无瑕，尽皆被白气缠绕，如同有生命一般，走过之后白气居然自动聚拢，看上去就如同有生命一般...
长袍拍打着双腿，此人看似步伐微慢，实则一步三影，转眼间就行至大殿前，抬头看去，只见白气中一座巍峨的大殿雄立，如同一个巨人俯视般看着来人。
大殿像是沉睡在白气里的恐怖存在，让来人感到无比压抑，特别是两旁的巨大雕像更是栩栩如生，仿佛他敢有半点不敬，那似狮似貅的雕像就要一口吞了他。
带着敬畏，此人小心翼翼道：“禀慕容总管，小姐又出跑出去了…”
“嗯，知道了，退下吧。”随即大殿内传出简单一句，很显然说话之人并不诧异，似乎是一件再简单平常不过的事情。
当白气再次覆盖这座金碧辉煌的殿宇时候，一声叹息也是无奈的响起。
“罢了，最多也到牢笼之地，或者域外。”
似乎是疲惫了，亦或者在思考，好一阵也没传出点点声响，大殿内的一位老人也是上前准备布开禁制，这也是是他的职责所在。
“慕容，最近还有什么事情吗？”
突然一道神念传入慕容总管神识，当下老人也是一顿，然后弯腰拱手道：“禀尊者，魔界那人已入圣，已然成为最年轻的圣者。”
“十多年前七彩域屏障变弱，各域士气高涨，联盟不时爆发大战。”
“子桑，即墨二族的尊者归入大罗，如今剩下各族也是被施压，想必归顺都是迟早的事情...”
慕容总管脸色很难看，这些消息一道比一道压抑，作为该族的总管，算算年纪也快接近一纪元了，从慕容一族的辉煌到现在的被压，老人此刻心里很不好受。
“不到五十年的圣者，魔界好气运啊，可惜仙儿只知道贪玩，同样年纪差距还是很大。”
那道神念带着无奈，但又不算是很责怪的意思回应道。
“尊者莫急，大小姐的天赋有目共睹，一切还需时间。”
慕容总管自信说道，慕容仙儿出生之日，各域皆是霞光异彩，天空云雷转动，真龙真凤齐鸣，一只金凤降落在慕容一族不肯离去，最为厉害的是凤巢一域更是亿万生灵齐呼女帝转世。
因为慕容仙儿出生的霞光，金凤以及凤巢的反应，让各族都无比羡慕，羡慕的同时当然也是带着恨，混元一族更是把慕容族视为眼中钉。

面对混元一族的猜疑，还有各族的警惕，这些年来，慕容一族都是安分守己，放纵慕容仙儿，没有在修炼上刻意压制她，反而培养了她肆意妄为，四处捣乱的性格。
故此也让各族降低了仇视，而五随着魔族最年轻的圣者出现在魔界，各族皆是说道慕容族的不是，好好的修炼胚子居然培养成了公主病，对此事，慕容族的人都是笑而不语...
“有点不对劲，破碎的地方越来越多，这哪是不稳定啊，完全是要破碎的节奏。”
此刻传送通道内一袭白色长裙的女子皱眉呢喃道。族内的传送阵都是定期修复，按道理不会这么破烂不堪，除非是阵法师不称职，要么就是有人为破坏，想到这里慕容仙儿眉头皱得更紧。
“有人忍耐不住了吗？”
“咚咚咚”传送通道四周传来声响，慕容仙儿暗道不好，看来的确是有人暗中使坏。
“哈哈哈，大小姐，这次出行就由老夫来送你一程吧！”
随着一声大笑，传送通道彻底崩塌震碎虚空，慕容仙儿置身在黑暗之中，在她前方出现两道黑色身影，全身弥漫着黑雾，且用特殊方法遮住面容，无法查看两人真实身份。
“藏头露尾之辈，这次又是哪一族的走狗？”
慕容仙儿丝毫不惧两人质问道，这样的事情这些年又不是第一次了，以混元族为首的各族每次总是各种试探。
“起阵！”
暗中传来一声大喝，虚空中瞬间亮起道道光束包裹三人，在慕容仙儿身后的虚空又冒出一道身影，这道身影口中喃喃自语双手结阵。
慕容仙儿转身看着这道身影凝重道“好大的手笔，圣阶阵法师，还是屏蔽天机的天演阵法！”
content_en:
In the Immortal Ancient Territory, the Murong clan's mansion is located in the Doufu clan.
The white air is continuous, the sun is shining down, and there are bright lights everywhere. The buildings here stand in the white air, as if they are growing out of the void, and the exposed corners are all carved with jade and are extremely luxurious. The tower hidden in the white air is looming, and the golden statue at the door looks like a lion, which looks extremely dazzling in the sun. In the peaceful and calm place, a figure hurries forward...
Wherever he stepped, the white mist automatically avoided, revealing clean and neat light-colored floor tiles, and the jade railings on both sides were pure white and flawless, all wrapped in white air, as if they were alive. After walking through, the white air gathered automatically, making it look like there was life...
The robe flapped against his legs. This person seemed to be walking slowly, but in reality he was walking in three steps. In a blink of an eye, he arrived in front of the main hall. Looking up, he saw a majestic main hall standing majestically in the white air, looking down at the visitor like a giant.
The main hall is like a terrifying existence sleeping in white air, which makes visitors feel extremely depressed, especially the huge statues on both sides are even more lifelike, as if if he dares to be disrespectful in the slightest, the lion-like statues will swallow him up in one gulp.
With awe, the man said cautiously: "Report to Manager Murong, the young lady has run away again..."
"Well, I understand, please step back." Then a simple sentence came from the hall. It was obvious that the person who spoke was not surprised. It seemed to be a simple and normal thing.
When the white air once again covered this magnificent palace, a helpless sigh was heard.
"That's all, the most we can do is go to the prison or outside the territory."
It seemed that he was tired or thinking, because there was no sound for a while. An old man in the hall also stepped forward to open the ban, which was also his responsibility.
"Murong, is there anything else happening recently?"
Suddenly, a spiritual thought came into the consciousness of Manager Murong. At that moment, the old man also paused, then bent down and cupped his hands and said: "Your Majesty, the man in the demon world has become a saint and has become the youngest saint."
"More than ten years ago, the barrier of the colorful domains became weak, the morale of each domain was high, and wars broke out in the alliance from time to time."
"Zisang, the sages of the Jimo and Mo tribes have joined Da Luo. Now the remaining tribes are also being put under pressure. It must be a matter of time that they surrender..."
Manager Murong's expression was ugly. These news were becoming more and more depressing. As the manager of the clan, he was almost an era old. From the glory of the Murong clan to the oppression now, the old man felt very uncomfortable at the moment.
"A saint who is less than fifty years old is so lucky in the demon world. It's a pity that Xian'er only knows how to play, and the age gap is still very big."
The divine thought responded with helplessness but not blame.
"Your Majesty, don't be anxious. The eldest lady's talent is obvious to all. Everything will take time."
Manager Murong said confidently that on the day Murong Xian'er was born, all areas were illuminated by brilliant rays of light, clouds and thunder rolled in the sky, real dragons and real phoenixes chirped together, a golden phoenix landed on the Murong clan and refused to leave. The most powerful thing was that in the Phoenix Nest area, hundreds of millions of creatures shouted for the reincarnation of the empress.
Because of the reaction of Xiaguang, Jinfeng and Fengchao when Murong Xianer was born, all the clans were extremely envious. Of course, the envy was also filled with hatred. The Hunyuan clan even regarded the Murong clan as a thorn in their side.
Faced with the suspicion of the Hunyuan clan and the vigilance of other clans, over the years, the Murong clan has kept to themselves and indulged Murong Xianer. They did not deliberately suppress her in cultivation, but instead cultivated her wanton and troublesome character.
Therefore, the hatred among all the tribes was reduced. As Wu, the youngest saint of the Demon Tribe, appeared in the Demon Realm, all the tribes said that it was wrong of the Murong Tribe. The embryo that had been cultivated so well actually developed princess disease. Regarding this matter, the people of the Murong Tribe laughed and said nothing...
"Something is wrong. There are more and more broken places. This is not unstable. It is completely broken."
Pass at this momentThe woman in a white dress walking into the aisle frowned and murmured. The teleportation arrays in the clan are regularly repaired, and it stands to reason that they would not be in such a dilapidated state unless the array master is incompetent or someone sabotaged them. Murong Xianer frowned even more when thinking of this.
"Is anyone unable to bear it?"
"Dong dong dong" sounds came from all around the transmission channel. Murong Xian'er secretly thought that something was wrong. It seemed that someone was indeed causing trouble secretly.
"Hahaha, Miss, I will give you a ride on this trip!"
With a loud laugh, the transmission channel completely collapsed and shattered the void. Murong Xian'er was in the darkness. Two black figures appeared in front of her. Their whole bodies were filled with black mist. Their faces were covered with special methods, making it impossible to see their true identities.
"You guys who hide their heads and show their tails, which clan are they the lackeys of this time?"
Murong Xian'er was not afraid of the two men's questioning at all. This was not the first time such a thing had happened in the past few years. The various tribes headed by the Hunyuan tribe always tried various methods every time.
"Get into formation!"
A loud shout came from the darkness, and beams of light instantly lit up in the void and enveloped the three of them. Another figure appeared in the void behind Murong Xianer. This figure murmured to himself and formed a formation with his hands.
Murong Xian'er turned around and looked at this figure and said solemnly, "What a great gesture, the Holy Level Array Master, or the Tianyan Formation that shields the secrets of heaven!"
